name: shopchat
description: Root workspace — run both backend and frontend together

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "green,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:frontend && SERVE_FRONTEND=true npm start --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
